appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Units Sold by Product (Weekend Pop-up)'
Bar for Product A is the leftmost bar, its height is below the 10,000 mark on the y-axis.
Bar for Product E is the tallest bar, its height is at the 80,000 mark on the y-axis.
Bar for Product B is the second from the right, its height is between 60,000 and 70,000 on the y-axis.
Bar for Product D is the third from the right, its height is between 60,000 and 70,000 on the y-axis.

printed_facts.fact: The bar for Product A corresponds to a value less than 10,000 units sold.
The bar for Product E corresponds to 80,000 units sold.
The bar for Product B corresponds to a value between 60,000 and 70,000 units sold.
The bar for Product D corresponds to a value between 60,000 and 70,000 units sold.
The bar for Product C corresponds to 20,000 units sold.

public_definitions: Review the weekend pop-up Units Sold by Product dashboard, then complete the Product A sales follow-up intake by selecting the appropriate product route.
Use the Units Sold by Product dashboard as the evidence source for the Product A sales follow-up route.
